title: Toyota Mark 2 Supra
author: Mastaree wizard
content: The second-generation Toyota Mark II Supra (A60), produced from 1982 to 1986, was sold primarily as the Celica Supra. It featured a longer hood to house an inline-six engine, distinctive 1980s pop-up headlights, and rear-wheel drive.

title: Toyota Touring Wagon returns
author: Wizard
content:
The Toyota Corolla Touring Wagon is a reliable, fuel-efficient 5-door station wagon famous for its spacious boot space and sturdy build. Classic older generations (like the AE100 series with 1.5L 5A-FE or 1.6L 4A-FE engines) are popular for practical daily driving, while modern global versions feature hybrid options and sleek styling.
